studies.title: 7th Day Shabbat
studies.summary: Which day is the seventh day? The Scriptures, the timing of Messiah’s death and resurrection, and the history of the calendar all point to the same answer.

studies.title: Who Is Israel?
studies.summary: In Scripture, Yisra’el is a people, a person and a land. A walk through the passages that define each, and why the land remains set apart to יהוה.

studies.title: The Roots of Christmas
studies.summary: Where Christmas came from, what Scripture says about borrowing pagan customs, and what that means for those who follow Yeshua.
